lines.text: Many learners say: Many peoples came.
People! There are many people here.

native.tip: كلمة people جمع بنفسها: “Many people came.” وليس “Many peoples came.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “Many peoples came.” 😅 كلمة people جمع بنفسها، فالجملة الصحيحة “Many people came.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “people”. كلمة people جمع بنفسها. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.tip: People is already a plural: “Many people came.” not “Many peoples came.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “Many peoples came.” 😅 People is already a plural, so the right sentence is “Many people came.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
